title: polyalthia membranacea
intro: Polyalthia membranacea, commonly known as the 'Malabar nut', is a plant species that belongs to the family Annonaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include treating fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions. The therapeutic actions of the Malabar nut include its anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and analgesic properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine.
